forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9580'
+title: 'T1 group 5 follow-up: test waits outside the JSC and runCode files with no second event'
+---
+Found on ^sf7h4gs (test rule T1). These unit test waits are not in the scope of T1 groups 3, 4 or 5 (MCP, shell and child process, JSC and runCode). No group card holds them.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event, or the test must fail before it waits.
+
+Cases:
+- Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SandboxPreflightTests.swift:146 gate.waitForWaitingCallers(atLeast:) — the internal test hook CanaryGate.waitForWaitingCallers in Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/SandboxPreflight.swift has no cancellation handler, thus no second event can end it. The owner permits a cancel handler on an EXISTING internal test hook (for example through TestHookWait or WaitList). The second event can then be the end of the task group of the callers.
+- Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/WebFetcherTests.swift:244 stub.waitForRequest() — the wait can also end on the end of the load task (EventRace.watch with untilOpen, or firstOf and the require macro).
+- Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/WebFetcherTests.swift:250 stub.waitForStop() — after the load ended by cancel. The stop of the load is the event under test. Check if a second event exists; else add its line to ^vg01093 with the reason.
+
+Do: the same rules as the T1 group cards. No .timeLimit, sleep, poll or retry. Do not delete a test. Keep each check the same. One full run of swift test. #elicitation-fixes #t1
\ No newline at end of file
